Somewhere in the cluster: a medium-sized dog with ears raised and hackles up, facing the same unseen threat. The composition is tight and claustrophobic, characters filling the frame, the arm-extended selfie angle creating a strong sense of foreground immersion. Style: hyper-realistic human character rendering with subtle stylized artistic quality, ultra-detailed, pure cinematic horror atmospheric vibe, correct anatomy throughout, no distortion, no extra limbs, consistent faces, no duplicate people. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K resolution.
